sounds.title: Sounds

workspace.urlHint: Used by the help center and the chat widget.
workspace.timezoneHint: Reports, SLA business days and timestamps in emails use it.
workspace.languageHint: The help center, satisfaction survey and chat widget follow each visitor's browser language. This one is used when we don't support theirs.
workspace.languageFixedHint: Show the help center, satisfaction survey and chat widget in {{language}} for every visitor, whatever their browser language. A brand with its own language uses that one.
workspace.helpCenterHint: A public site with your published knowledge base articles.

workspace.brandHint: Used by the chat widget and the buttons in outgoing email.

workspace.hcFaviconHint: The small icon in the browser tab.
workspace.picturesHint: Pictures make the inbox easier to scan. Uploaded pictures always win.

workspace.collabReplyToHint: The Reply-To of such a reply, unless the member picks another. Their address: answers go to the address it was sent from and come back to the ticket from there. The ticket's address: answers go to the team's address like any email.

display.title: Statuses and priorities

danger.transferBody: They get full control, including deleting the workspace. You stay on as an admin.

email.unverifiedHint: Notification emails go only to a confirmed address.
email.unverified: Confirm your email address first. Notification emails go only to a confirmed address.
